title: coelophragmus auriculatus
intro: Coelophragmus auriculatus, commonly known as Ear-dropping coelophragmus or ear dropping scurvy grass, is a small, flowering plant native to North America. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Coelophragmus auriculatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These constituents work together to provide relief from various health conditions, including fever, sore throats, and skin irritations.
